instruction: I'm starting C++ development. Please show me how to install the C/C++ extension in Visual Studio Code.

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing the C/C++ extension (ms-vscode.cpptools) in VSCode. The evaluator verifies installation by running 'code --list-extensions' and checking if the output contains the C/C++ extension ID.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the core requirement: checking if C/C++ extension (ms-vscode.cpptools) is installed in VSCode
Metric function correctly implements containment check logic and properly handles the 'rules' parameter (receives rules dict directly from get_rule)
Expected value correctly specifies the official C/C++ extension ID

Command uses pipe operator in array form without shell=true, which may fail to execute the grep filter. However, if code --list-extensions executes successfully, the metric can still check for the extension ID in the full output
Verification logic is semantically complete - checks the exact requirement stated in the instruction
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add 'shell': true to the result config to ensure pipe operator works correctly, OR remove the grep from the command array since the metric already performs containment checking
Recommended command fix: either use {"command": "code --list-extensions | grep ms-vscode.cpptools", "shell": true} OR simplify to {"command": ["code", "--list-extensions"]} without grep
